svg.title: Shono project pipeline
svg.desc: Validate audio and declared dataset splits. Use an existing Whisper checkpoint or optionally fine-tune with PyTorch and Transformers. Transcribe short clips with Transformers, or long recordings with Silero, CTranslate2 Whisper, per-segment checks, and timing merge. Compare text against held-out references with raw and normalized WER and CER. Optional provider predictions use the same scoring path. Optional pyannote turns label transcript segments and are scored separately against CSV or RTTM speaker references. Export scores and reports. Whisper windows include padding within 30 seconds. Confidence intervals need at least two recording or speaker blocks. This prototype has no project-trained checkpoint or measured model accuracy; word alignment is unverified.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace
IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: Whisper windows are ≤30 s including padding. *Intervals need ≥2 recording/speaker blocks.
Prototype · no project-trained checkpoint or measured model accuracy. Word alignment is unverified.
